page.notes: The catchword "magi-" at the foot is a hyphenated word that continues on the next page. The first word "instrumentis" begins with a decorated initial. The word "proposita" uses a Latin-set "a" that may be a typesetting variant. Two words are uncertain: "obstruere" appears printed as "ob struere" split across the line end, and "fruftra" may be "frustra" in print.
